info.name: Construction.Account.Admin Account Management Issue Root Cause Categories API

params.name: include
params.description: Add ‘include=rootcauses’ to add the root causes for each category.

params.name: limit
params.description: Add limit=20 to limit the results count (together with the offset to support pagination).

params.name: offset
params.description: Add offset=20 to get partial results (together with the limit to support pagination)

params.name: filter[updatedAt]
params.description: Retrieves root cause categories updated at the specified date and time, in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of supported root cause categories and root causes that you can allocate to an issue. For example, communication and coordination.
